World.headline: US-Iran Conflict Escalates with Airstrikes and Naval Blockade
World.summary: The US-Iran conflict has intensified with a sixth consecutive night of US airstrikes on dozens of Iranian military targets, including coastal systems, air defence sites, and logistics. At least seven people were reportedly killed in strikes on Iranian bridges, as the US expands its military campaign and tightens a naval blockade around the Strait of Hormuz. Iran has retaliated with missile attacks against US-allied Gulf nations, prompting warnings from the IEA about global oil and gas security.

Science.headline: Scientists Discover Superheated Water 1.3 km Below Atlantic, May Fuel Sunless Life
Science.summary: Scientists have made a remarkable discovery of superheated water deep beneath the Atlantic Ocean floor, 1.3 kilometers down. The chemical composition of this water strongly resembles vent fluids found at the Lost City hydrothermal field, suggesting a hidden, hydrogen-rich water source. This finding offers crucial insights into how life might sustain itself without sunlight and its implications for potential extraterrestrial life forms.
key_points: Superheated water found 1.3 km beneath the Atlantic Ocean floor.
Chemical makeup matches Lost City vent fluids, indicating a hidden hydrogen source.
